items.title: Remove deposited green cuttings (grass/branch clippings) from the municipal green area
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for compliance: 20.01.2026. This is used as printed, no counting or delivery-fiction needed for this order deadline.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Administrative Court against the Ordnungsverfügung
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Tue 23.12.2025 by a general authority (city Ordnungsamt, not a tax office), so the 4-calendar-day delivery fiction applies without moving for weekends/holidays (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW / general rule): 23.12.2025 + 4 days = Sat 27.12.2025 = deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe), not shifted despite falling on a Saturday and near the Christmas holidays. The one-month Klage period (§ 74 VwGO) begins the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 27.01.2026. That date is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO / § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO is needed.

warnings: The letter threatens estimated costs of 480,00 € for a substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) only if the removal deadline of 20.01.2026 is missed; this is a contingent cost, not a currently due payment, and no separate due date or invoice for it is given yet.
